sources.snippet: SmolLM3 Evaluation Relevant source files This document covers the comprehensive evaluation framework for SmolLM3 models using the LightEval library. The evaluation system supports both base and instruct model variants, covering mathematical reasoning, knowledge benchmarks, instruction following, and multilingual capabilities.

sources.snippet: Hugging Face calls the release an "engineering blueprint" and the pretraining used public datasets throughout, which is what puts a 3B model in the same openness tier as OLMo and Pythia. Verified 2026-08-13 via the SmolLM3 release post, the SmolLM3-3B model card and the huggingface/smollm repository.

sources.title: SmolLM3 — Hugging Face's Fully Open 3B Model | FreeAPIHub
sources.snippet: SmolLM3 is Hugging Face's fully open 3B model with dual-mode reasoning, a 64K context (128K extended), six languages and Apache 2.0. Runs on a laptop.
